description: This file defines the ClassDefinition class within the WPEFramework::JavaScript namespace. It manages JavaScript class definitions, including adding and removing functions, and provides access to class metadata. The class features static methods for retrieving class maps and specific instances, as well as iterator types for traversing class definitions and functions.

classes.name: ClassDefinition
classes.description: Manages JavaScript class definitions, their associated functions, and metadata within the plugin framework.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a JavaScriptFunction to the class definition.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a JavaScriptFunction from the class definition.

methods.name: GetFunctions
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the functions associated with this class.

methods.name: GetClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class.

methods.name: GetExtName
methods.description: Returns the extension name associated with the class.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of a ClassDefinition by class name.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns the static map of class definitions.

methods.name: GetClassDefinitions
methods.description: Provides an iterator over all class definitions.
